common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.loadFailedBody: Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.tenantOffline: This shop is not open right now.
errors.planLimited: The plan does not allow that.

shell.search: Find a shop by name or address

signIn.title: Operator sign-in
signIn.lead: The platform console. Separate from any seller's dashboard.
signIn.noRecovery: No "forgot password". Losing the authenticator and the backup codes is recovered by a logged break-glass action (ADM-18).
signIn.locked: Five tries failed on this account in 15 minutes. Wait, then try again. Until then a right password or code is refused too.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enroll.lead: Every operator account needs it (ADM-01). Scan with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.lead: Each works once if you lose the authenticator. Shown only this one time.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.lead: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one backup code.

account.title: Account
account.codesHint: {{count}} of 10 unused. Regenerating replaces every existing code; confirm with your password and a fresh authenticator code.
account.breakGlass: Losing both the authenticator and the codes is recovered by a logged break-glass action on the database, after which 2FA must be re-enrolled (ADM-18).
account.newConsequence: The ten current codes stop working the moment these are made.
account.generated: The old codes no longer work. Save these.

queue.lead: Payments Lytro's phones could not match, and those still waiting for a receipt. Check each against the wallet statement. Approving activates the plan or credits the balance, once.
queue.emptyHint: New wallet payments appear here when a seller submits a TrxID. Ones a Lytro phone matches clear by themselves.
queue.statement: Match this against the wallet statement before approving.
queue.approveTopUp: {{a}} is credited to {{shop}}'s balance, once. The ledger records you and the time.
queue.approveReview: This accepts {{a}} against a quote of {{q}} and activates it anyway. To activate nothing, put the money on the balance instead.
queue.arrivedHelp: Change this only if the wallet statement says otherwise.
queue.rejectLead: Nothing is credited. The seller reads your note on the plan page and can submit again.
queue.rejectHint: e.g. No payment of ৳699 from 01711… in the statement for 20 Oct
queue.rejected: Rejected. The seller will see your note.
queue.creditOpen: Put the money on the balance instead
queue.creditHelp: What the wallet statement shows. Needed when no receipt says.
queue.addonActivates: Approving activates the add-on at once and raises the limit; the invoice follows. Rejecting leaves the shop as it is.
queue.approvePlan: {{shop}} goes on {{plan}} for {{term}}. The invoice is issued. Approving twice has no second effect.
queue.creditConsequence: Nothing is activated. {{a}} goes on {{shop}}'s balance, once, and any add-ons on this payment are cancelled.

plans.lead: A row per plan, a column per billing term, a price in every cell that is offered. Cells save on Enter.
plans.rule1: Upgrades go up in rank; a plan with any snapshot cannot be deleted, only taken off sale (PLN-08, PLN-16).
plans.rule2: An empty cell means "not offered for this term" (TRM-13).
plans.name: Name
plans.versionNote: v{{v}} recorded {{d}}. Saving records v{{n}}; shops already on v{{v}} keep it until they renew (PLN-02).
plans.deleteBlocked_one: {{count}} shop is on this plan; take it off sale instead.
plans.deleteBlocked_other: {{count}} shops are on this plan; take it off sale instead.
plans.deleteBlockedOther: Its prices, payments or past versions still name it; take it off sale instead.
plans.deleteConsequence: It goes for good. No shop, price or payment names it (PLN-08).
plans.priceWhole: A price is whole taka, above zero.
plans.unsavedCell: {{plan}}, {{term}} isn't saved yet. Press Enter in the cell to save it, or Esc to undo.
plans.emptyHint: A shop can't buy anything until a plan is on sale.

billingTerms.lead: How long a plan can be bought for. A retired term stays on the invoices that used it.
billingTerms.discountHelp: Pre-fills a plan's price for this term; the stored price is what counts.
billingTerms.singleHelp: Only that shop sees it (TRM-14). Leave empty otherwise.
billingTerms.singleFixed: Set when the term is made; it can't move to another shop.
billingTerms.retireConsequence_one: It stops being offered from now. {{count}} invoice keeps it as bought. It cannot be deleted while it exists (TRM-05).
billingTerms.retireConsequence_other: It stops being offered from now. {{count}} invoices keep it as bought. It cannot be deleted while they exist (TRM-05).
billingTerms.deleteConsequence: It goes for good. No price, payment or shop names it (TRM-05).
billingTerms.emptyHint: A plan can't be bought until a term has a price.

rates.lead: Per-use charges. A new value applies from the next charge and is never retroactive; the old one stays in the history.
rates.notice: Offer a rate-change notice to shops
rates.saved: Saved. Applies from the next charge.

settings.lead: Platform-wide values that are not rates. Each is live the moment it saves and goes on the audit log with your reason.
settings.timelineHint: A shop whose paid period ends on day 0.
settings.tlReadOnly: Read-only: storefront offline, owner and staff only view and export
settings.tlLocked: Locked: only the owner signs in, to renew or export
settings.tlArchived: Archived: only a purchase screen, data kept
settings.versionWarn: Change this the same day new text is published. New accounts record this version; accounts that already accepted keep theirs.
settings.sendersHelp: One sender on each line, as it appears on the phone.

groups.2: Lifecycle after a paid period ends

orderLimit.allow_with_prompt: Allow, with a prompt to upgrade

settingNames.new_shop_payment_cap_days: A shop counts as new for

wallets.lead: The bKash and Nagad numbers sellers send plan payments and top-ups to, in the order shown. Sellers see these rows exactly as listed.
wallets.gatewaysHint: Gateway credentials for Lytro's own wallets arrive with ADM-10.
wallets.label: Label, optional
wallets.removeConsequence: Sellers stop seeing it at once. Payments already matched to it stay on their invoices.
wallets.emptyHint: Sellers have nowhere to send a plan payment until one is added.

later.title: Not built yet
later.body: This screen is drawn for the requirement it serves; the backend does not serve it today. The place it will take in the navigation is already reserved.

leads.reports: Shops by state and plan, platform revenue by week, month, quarter and year, top consumers of storage, bandwidth and SMS with CSV export.
leads.audit: Every operator action across all shops: actor, action, shop, old and new value, reason, time. Filter by shop, actor, action and date. Entries can never be edited.
leads.inbox: Tickets from owners and staff with the shop, plan, state and recent errors attached; filters by status, plan and age; canned replies; internal notes; overdue flagged against the plan's response target.
leads.notices: Notices to shops: title, Bangla and English body, category, severity, audience, publish and end times, pinned, acknowledgement required; templates for rate change, maintenance, outage and policy; delivery and read counts.
leads.verification: The identity queue: submissions with the NID masked, status history, the three images through 5-minute signed links, approve or reject with a reason, reveal audited, four-eyes where two operators exist.
leads.manual: Record a purchase, renewal, upgrade or top-up paid outside the normal flow: shop, kind, plan and term or amount, wallet, TrxID unique platform-wide, sender, time, evidence, reason; a second confirmation above ৳10,000 or ten entries a day; reversals, never edits; a daily digest by email. Shopper "I have paid" claims land in the same queue.

today.title: Today
today.lead: What needs a person, then what changed.
today.figuresHint: Shops by state and plan, revenue by week, month, quarter and year, top consumers (ADM-09). Not built yet.
today.unreadDetail: You're told at {{n}} in a day

reviewReasons.amount: The amount isn't what was quoted.
reviewReasons.sender: The money came from a number the seller didn't name.
reviewReasons.old_receipt: The receipt is older than this request.
reviewReasons.transaction_id_used: This TrxID is already on another payment.
reviewReasons.request_closed: The seller's request had closed when the money arrived.
reviewReasons.low_balance: The balance was too low for the fee.
reviewReasons.order_closed: The order had closed when the money arrived.
reviewReasons.by_hand: Sent to be checked by hand.

shops.lead: Every shop on the platform. Search by name or address; act from the shop page.
shops.filtersLater: Filters by state and plan arrive with the full search (ADM-02).
shops.emptyHint: Try part of the name or the address.

shop.suspendedNote: Suspended {{d}} by {{who}}: "{{r}}". The storefront is offline; the owner keeps the dashboard and can top up.
shop.overridesHint: A value set here replaces the plan's for this shop only (PLN-11).
shop.overridesNone: No overrides. The plan's limits apply as they are.
shop.laterDetailHint: Balance and frozen flag, usage against every limit, errors in 24 h, failed SMS and bookings, last sign-in, open tickets, business summary (ADM-03). Waits for its endpoint.
shop.laterActionsHint: Every suspend, adjustment, assignment and override with who, when and why, from the platform audit log (ADM-08).
shop.laterViewAsHint: A read-only support session the owner approves from their dashboard (ADM-05).
shop.laterIdentityHint: Opens a NID check the owner completes from the dashboard (KYC-01).
shop.suspendConsequence: The storefront and landing pages go offline at once. The owner keeps the dashboard, can read orders and top up, and sees your reason. Their lifecycle state is untouched; restoring lifts only this.
shop.restoreConsequence: The storefront comes back online within a minute. The suspension stays on the audit log.
shop.adjustConsequence: A correction, not a refund. Negative takes money off. The entry appears on the shop's statement with your reason (BAL-17).
shop.assignConsequence: Puts the shop on the plan now, without payment (PLN-17). With an expiry the shop lapses into grace on that date; without one it stays until you change it.
shop.overrideConsequence: Replaces one limit of the plan for this shop only. Removing it later restores the plan's value.
shop.reasonHelp: Required. Goes on the platform audit log.
shop.pageRestoreConsequence: It takes payments again within a minute. The suspension stays on the audit log.
shop.pageSuspendConsequence: Within a minute, new payments are refused and open pages show "unavailable". The rest of the shop stays open, and this shop's open reports are marked acted on.
shop.capLine: {{a}} a day for its first {{n}} days
shop.capConsequence: A capped shop younger than {{n}} days can take at most {{a}} online in a day, counting payments still open. By default a pay-as-you-go shop is capped and a shop on a plan is not.
shop.credentialsHint: Every use of this shop's stored gateway keys, never the keys themselves.
shop.credentialsLead: For a dispute or something odd: a sudden jump in calls, or a call with no payment behind it.
shop.credentialsEmptyHint: This shop has no stored gateway keys in use.
shop.addonsHint: Active add-ons raise this shop's limits on top of the plan snapshot and the overrides; packs are used up as they go (PLN-13, UPG-14).
shop.effectiveHint: The plan's value, or the override that replaces it, plus add-ons. What every check reads.
shop.capDefaultOn: As its kind says (on, it is pay-as-you-go)
shop.capDefaultOff: As its kind says (off, it is on a plan)
shop.removeConsequence: {{limit}} goes back to the plan's value for {{shop}}.

reports.lead: Shoppers report a payment page that looks wrong. Open the page, suspend it, or dismiss the report. Each is audited.
reports.emptyHint: A report appears here the moment a shopper sends one.
reports.dismissConsequence: Nothing is done to the shop. The report moves to Dismissed, and the dismissal is on the audit log.

reportReasons.asked_for_pin: Asked for a PIN or code
reportReasons.wrong_shop: Not the shop they ordered from

phones.lead: The phones that read messages on Lytro's own wallets and match sellers' payments by themselves. What they can't match waits in the payment queue.
phones.offlineWarning: {{name}} has been offline {{ago}}. Payments to its wallet wait in the queue until it reports again.
phones.emptyHint: Until one is paired, every seller's wallet payment waits in the queue for you.
phones.pairLead: For Lytro's own wallets, not a shop's.
phones.pairStep1: Put the wallet's SIM in the phone and install the Lytro listener app.
phones.pairStep2: Open the app and type this code.
phones.title: Listener phones
phones.revokeConsequence: Within seconds this phone stops sending receipts and the app says it was revoked. Another phone can still be paired.
phones.blockConsequence: It can pair with no shop again, and every phone on it is revoked now.
phones.pairFailed: The code didn't come. Try again.

receipts.lead: What Lytro's phones forwarded, newest first.
receipts.search: Start of a TrxID, a sender number or an amount
receipts.redacted: Its text has been removed, as every receipt's is after a while.
receipts.emptyHint: Receipts appear as Lytro's phones send them.

unread.lead: Messages from a wallet's own sender that look like a payment but couldn't be read. Only their wording is kept, with numbers, people and notes removed, and how many came each day. A wording here means the reader needs updating.
unread.emptyHint: Every wallet message in this period could be read.

addons.lead: What a shop can buy on top of its plan: limit add-ons, packs and features (PLN-13). Prices are per month; a retired item cannot be bought, and ones already bought run to their end.
addons.emptyHint: A shop can only buy what's listed here.
addons.rule: A limit add-on and a feature renew with the plan unless the shop turns renewal off; a pack adds once and carries over until used. Pay-as-you-go shops renew in 30-day periods from the balance (PLN-14). Allowances arrive with Phase 7 (PLN-20).
addons.consequence: A price change applies to new purchases and to renewals from now on; an add-on already running keeps its price to its end.
addons.keyHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. It can't change later.
addons.unitHelp: What one bought unit adds: 500 products, 1 seat, 1 GB, 10 GB, 100,000 requests. A feature has none.
addons.priceHelp: Whole taka. A longer term is monthly × months; mid-period it is prorated by the days left (PLN-14). A pack is a one-off at this price.
addons.retireConsequence_one: No shop can buy it from now. The {{count}} running one continues to its end and will not renew; its owner sees that in their dashboard (PLN-13).
addons.retireConsequence_other: No shop can buy it from now. The {{count}} running ones continue to their end and will not renew; their owners see that in their dashboards (PLN-13).
addons.retiredToast: {{name}} retired. No shop can buy it from now.

shopTypes.lead: What a new product starts with in a shop of each type: stock unit, tracking, suggested categories and attributes, and the fields shown up front (PST-02, PST-05).
shopTypes.consequence: Applies to products created from now in shops of this type. Existing products do not change.
shopTypes.categoriesHelp: Offered as chips on a new shop's empty categories page (PST-02).
shopTypes.upFrontHelp: The rest sit under "More settings" on the product form (PST-05).
shopTypes.saved: {{name}} saved. It applies to products made from now.
shopTypes.emptyHint: They come from the platform's seed.

attributes.lead: The attributes every shop sees, with their platform values. Shops' own attributes are never listed here (ATL-01).
attributes.name: Name
attributes.consequence: Every shop sees it from now. Its type never changes afterwards; renaming and retiring are the only edits (ATL-01).
attributes.retireNote: Retired values stay on products that use them and stop being offered (ATL-05).
attributes.created: {{name}} added. Every shop sees it from now.
attributes.emptyHint: Add one and every shop sees it.

optionSets.lead: Values inserted in one tap: a set offered first to shops of its type, then to every shop (ATR-16).
optionSets.consequence: Values shops already inserted from this set stay theirs; editing changes only what is offered next.
optionSets.name: Name
optionSets.type: Offer first to shops of type
optionSets.deleteConsequence: It stops being offered. Values shops already inserted from it stay with them.
optionSets.emptyHint: A set puts many values on a product in one tap.
